about: Scripted prior sessions ('session 0') run with real headless Claude Code on the v0 project, in order. Each is captured via devmem capture (stream-json). Their edits are committed to the project; their records become the history fixtures. After these, an UNCAPTURED human refactor (v2) makes S0c/S0d memories stale.

sessions.prompt: Let's plan the daily login reward. Do NOT edit or create any files in this session; we will implement it next session. Decisions we agreed on: (1) coins are granted only through CurrencyService.add with the reason string "daily_reward"; (2) the day boundary is 00:00 UTC, not server local time; (3) reward is 20 coins plus 10 per streak day; (4) the streak caps at 7 days, as a new Config.DailyStreakCap = 7; (5) missing a full UTC day resets the streak to 1. Look at the relevant code and reply with a short implementation plan (which files change, which data fields to add) that restates these decisions.

Bug report: players who bought 'Speed Coil' lost it after we renamed the item to 'Speed Boots', because inventories store item names. Decision: inventories must store numeric ItemCatalog ids, never names; names are display-only and can change. Update DataService, Types and all callers to store and compare ids, and migrate old saved data on load: map string entries via ItemCatalog.getByName, plus the legacy name 'Speed Coil' -> id 1; drop unknown names with a Log.warn. Follow the existing project conventions.
Grunts feel too weak. Raise Grunt damage from 10 to 12. Brute damage stays at 25.

Players report double purchases when they spam the Buy button. Make sure the server-side BuyItem remote handler rejects purchases during the cooldown, and make the client disable the Buy button until the server responds with InventoryChanged or 1 second passes.
Add a /help admin command that lists the available admin commands to the admin who typed it (use Log.info on the server; no new UI).

uncaptured_refactor_v2: Move enemy damage from the EnemyService.DAMAGE table into Config.Enemies[kind].damage (Grunt 12, Brute 25); EnemyService reads Config; DAMAGE table removed.
Rename the remote BuyItem to PurchaseItem everywhere.
